description: This Java source file defines the CommandStrategyProvider class, which provides appropriate command strategies based on HTTP method and resource URL patterns for the Fineract batch command module. It initializes a set of command strategies with regex patterns for matching various API endpoints and supports retrieving strategies via Spring application context.

classes.name: CommandStrategyProvider
classes.description: Provides command strategies based on request context, using regex patterns to match API endpoints and HTTP methods. It supports dynamic retrieval of strategies via Spring application context.

methods.name: getCommandStrategy
methods.description: Returns an appropriate CommandStrategy based on the CommandContext, supporting versioned and non-versioned resources.

methods.name: internalGetCommandStrategy
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve a CommandStrategy from the commandStrategies map or fallback to UnknownCommandStrategy.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Static method that initializes the commandStrategies map with regex patterns and corresponding strategy bean names for various API endpoints.
